DomainData.MainInfoText: Har qanday veb-saytga tashrif buyurganingizda, brauzeringizga maʼlumot yozilishi yoki oʻqilishi mumkin, bu aksariyat hollarda cookie shaklida boʻladi. Bu maʼlumotlar siz haqingizda, siz tanlagan narsalar, qurilmangiz haqida boʻlishi mumkin yoki saytni xohishingizga moslash uchun ishlatiladi. Maʼlumotlarda sizning shaxsingiz koʻrsatilmaydi, ammo veb-saytlarni sizga moslashi mumkin. Ayrim cookie fayllarga ruxsat bermasligingiz mumkin. Batafsil bilish uchun turli toifa nomlariga bosing va odatiy sozlamalarni oʻzgartiring. Ammo ayrim cookie fayllar bloklansa, sayt va taqdim etilayotgan xizmatlarga taʼsir koʻrsatishi mumkin.
DomainData.AlertNoticeText: Saytimiz toʻgʻri ishlashi, kontent va reklamalar moslashtirilishi, ijtimoiy tarmoq funksiyalari taqdim etilishi va trafikni tahlil qilish uchun cookie fayllardan foydalanamiz. Bundan tashqari, saytimizdan qanday foydalanganingiz haqida ijtimoiy tarmoqlar, reklama va tahlil boʻyicha hamkorlarimizga maʼlumot beramiz.Cookie Notice
DomainData.CookieListDescription: Cookie fayli kichkina (matnli) fayl boʻlib, birorta sayt ochilganida brauzeringiz qurilmaga saqlashi soʻraladi, shu orqali siz tanlagan til yoki login maʼlumotlari kabi siz haqingizdagi axborotlar eslab qolinadi. Bu cookielarni biz qoʻyamiz va ular birinchi tomon cookielari deb ataladi. Biz uchinchi tomon cookielarini ham ishlatamiz, ular tashrif buyurilgan saytning domenidan boshqa domen cookielari boʻlib, ular reklama va marketing maqsadlarida qoʻyiladi. Aniqroq aytganda, cookie va boshqa kuzatuv texnologiyalarini quyidagi maqsadlarda ishlatamiz:

Groups.GroupDescription: Bu fayllar veb-saytning ishlashi uchun zarur boʻlib, bizning tizimimizda oʻchirib qoʻyilmaydi. Bular odatda siz soʻragan xizmatlarga, masalan, maxfiylik sozlamalarini belgilash, tizimga kirish yoki shakllarni toʻldirish amallariga javob tariqasida qoʻyiladi. Brauzeringiz bu cookielarni bloklashi yoki ular haqida xabar berishini belgilab qoʻyishingiz mumkin, ammo bu holda saytning ayrim qismlari ishlamasligi mumkin.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: AWSALB
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with the Amazon Web Services Elastic Load Balancing functionality for routing client request on the server.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: OptanonConsent
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is set by the cookie compliance solution from OneTrust. It stores information about the categories of cookies the site uses and whether visitors have given or withdrawn consent for the use of each category. This enables site owners to prevent cookies in each category from being set in the users browser, when consent is not given. The cookie has a normal lifespan of one year, so that returning visitors to the site will have their preferences remembered. It contains no information that can identify the site visitor.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: AWSALBCORS
FirstPartyCookies.description: This AWS cookie is used for load balancing.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: OptanonAlertBoxClosed
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is set by websites using certain versions of the cookie law compliance solution from OneTrust.  It is set after visitors have seen a cookie information notice and in some cases only when they actively close the notice down.  It enables the website not to show the message more than once to a user.  The cookie has a one year lifespan and contains no personal information.

Groups.GroupDescription: Bu cookie fayllar tashriflar sonini va trafik manbalarini sanash imkonini beradi, shu orqali biz saytning ishlashini tekshirib, yaxshilashimiz mumkin. Qaysi sahifalar eng koʻp va eng kam ishlatilishi, tashrif buyurganlar qaysi sahifalarni ochishi haqida bilishga yordam beradi. Bu cookie fayllar toʻplagan maʼlumotlar jamlanadi va anonim koʻrinishga keltiriladi. Agar bu cookie fayllariga ruxsat bermasangiz, saytimizga qachon tashrif buyurganingizni bilmaymiz.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _gid
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics. This appears to be a new cookie and as of Spring 2017 no information is available from Google.  It appears to store and update a unique value for each page visited._gid

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _gat
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics, according to documentation it is used to throttle the request rate - limiting the collection of data on high traffic sites. It expires after 10 minutes.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _ga
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics - which is a significant update to Google's more commonly used analytics service. This cookie is used to distinguish unique users by assigning a randomly generated number as a client identifier. It is included in each page request in a site and used to calculate visitor, session and campaign data for the sites analytics reports.  By default it is set to expire after 2 years, although this is customisable by website owners.
